definitions.explanation: The logical flow or coherent sequence of an argument, explanation, or course of action. Implies things should proceed in a reasonable, orderly manner.

definitions.gloss: proper course of action; right way; proper procedure
definitions.explanation: The correct or socially expected way of handling a situation. Implies there is a right process to follow.

examples.japanese: {筋道|すじみち}を{立|た}てて{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain in a logical, coherent manner.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}の{筋道|すじみち}がわからなくなった。
examples.english: I lost track of the logic of the story.

examples.japanese: {筋道|すじみち}の{通|とお}った{意見|いけん}だったので、みんなが{納得|なっとく}した。
examples.english: It was a well-reasoned opinion, so everyone was convinced.

examples.japanese: まずは{上司|じょうし}に{報告|ほうこく}するのが{筋道|すじみち}だ。
examples.english: The proper thing to do is to report to your supervisor first.

examples.japanese: {筋道|すじみち}を{踏|ふ}まずに{勝手|かって}に{進|すす}めるのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not good to proceed on your own without following proper procedure.

examples.japanese: {借|か}りたものは{返|かえ}すのが{筋道|すじみち}というものだ。
examples.english: Returning what you borrowed is the right thing to do.

notes:
USAGE:
{筋道|すじみち}を{立|た}てる (to organize logically) and {筋道|すじみち}が{通|とお}る (to be logical/reasonable) are the most important collocations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋道|すじみち}を{立|た}てる (to organize logically; to lay things out coherently)
- {筋道|すじみち}が{通|とお}る (to be logical; to make sense)
- {筋道|すじみち}を{踏|ふ}む (to follow proper procedure)
- {筋道|すじみち}の{通|とお}った (well-reasoned; logical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論理|ろんり}: logic — more academic and formal
- {道理|どうり}: reason; principle — focuses on natural justice or moral principle
- {筋|すじ}: thread; line — shorter form sometimes used with same meaning
